title: Projektetage Intro Flow Drag Scale
description: Fix projektetage intro slides 0-6 where dragging text shoots elements out quickly; slide 9 (canvas) works. Root cause likely sectionVisualScale using tall nested reveal stack offsetHeight vs viewport-sized client rect.
summary:
Fixed intro slide text drag shooting across the screen (pixel vs fraction).

Root cause: flow-layout drags store movement in pixels, but `isFlowPixelOffsetTransform` treated small values like `{ x: 0.5, y: 0.2 }` as normalized slide frames. The UI then applied `left: 50%` / `top: 20%` on the wrapper instead of `translate3d`, so a few pixels of drag jumped across the slide.

Fix:
- With measured ink size, pixel offset is true unless the transform is a full normalized frame (`isNormalizedSlideFrame`).
- Flow slides always use the pixel drag path in `attachPointerGesture` and start from `{0,0}` via `flowDispositionManipulationRect`.
- Pointer delta uses `elementVisualScale` on the content node for reveal zoom.

76 renderer tests pass.
